mapper.insert: MERGE INTO EMAIL_AUTH ea USING DUAL ON (ea.EMAIL = #{email}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}, EXPIRE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '3' MINUTE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMAIL, AUTH_CODE, EXPIRE_TIME) VALUES (#{email}, #{authCode}, SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '3' MINUTE)
